adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when credential sharing is enabled it POSTs to `process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` with only `calcomUserId` and `appSlug` in the body and no authentication header/signature. Separately, the new inbound webhook `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts` enforces a shared secret via `CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` and `CALCOM_WEBHOOK_HEADER_NAME`. The diff therefore shows an asymmetry/incompleteness in the security model for the new “credential sync” feature: there is no built-in way for the external sync endpoint to verify the request came from Cal.com. However, the claim that this *definitively* lets “any party ... mint/fetch live OAuth access tokens” can’t be verified from the diff because the external endpoint implementation isn’t shown and could enforce its own auth/network controls.
